Elena / Orbit Legal — thanks for the redline. I've reviewed Orbit_DPA_redline.docx and attached our response (Redwood_DPA_redline_response.docx) with inline explanations. High-level summary:

- Data transfers: we will use SCCs for transfers from the EU unless Orbit requires a dedicated private deployment. We added an explicit cross-border transfer clause and referenced the latest EU SCC set.
- Subprocessors: we've accepted the majority of the scope questions but proposed a carve-out for ephemeral caching and CDN providers; full inventory attached in the response.
- Liability & caps: we counterproposed a narrow revision to the liability cap and clarified the exclusions for indemnity tied to third-party payment processors.
- Signing: we prepared a DocuSign envelope (link below); Redwood prefers DocuSign but can accommodate AdobeSign on request.

Proposed next steps:
1) Orbit Legal to confirm the SCC approach and the finalized subprocessor list (we can incorporate via an Exhibit).
2) Finalize liability language or confirm a business-level exception via procurement.
3) Execute via DocuSign; I set a 7-day target to get to signature if no further redlines.

If helpful, happy to schedule a 30-minute call Friday to walk through the redline.
